annotations.title: How to test a fix: agent checks and the person’s script

description: The test plan for something that has been built or fixed. For a guide (by slug) or a component (by query) returns the pass criteria, the checks an agent can run itself, the checks only a person can do (which keys to press and what should happen, as a two-minute script), the guide’s limits, and a Playwright regression test skeleton. An agent or automation can’t establish the person’s checks.

locale.description: Language of the answer and the guides: en (default) or ja. English answers cite EN 301 549 and Section 508; Japanese answers cite JIS X 8341-3:2016.

query.description: Or a component or problem in words, when the slug is unknown

slug.description: A guide slug from find_fix or before_building

name: test_steps
